svg.text: Acquired, Sent out, Returned, and Disposed (#067): from + Log, on the vehicle's page, and in the Timeline. Only what the person may record is offered.
1 · + Log: where the four lifecycle kinds go (Sent out and Returned for a Maintainer; Acquired and Disposed for the vehicle's Admin)
A · Below the everyday kinds, under "Vehicle's life"
Phone · a Maintainer, vehicle not out
To a shop, and when it's due back
Phone · the Admin in Admin mode, while it's out
+ Everything to log is in one place.
+ Only what fits now: Returned only while it's out,
Sent out only while it isn't, Acquired only if
none is recorded yet, Disposed only once.
+ Drivers never see the section (it's empty).
− The sheet gets taller for the Admin.
B · One "Vehicle's life…" tile that opens the four
+ The everyday sheet stays as short as today.
− One more tap, for things done rarely anyway.
− A Maintainer's step 2 has one tile in it.
2 · The forms: the usual log form (When and where, readings, notes, photos), with the kind's own section first
Acquired: From (seller, dealer, maker; optional), Price, then
the starting readings. Shown first for a vehicle with no events.
Returned: "Back from Joe's Auto (sent 14 Nov)" shown, not chosen;
Final cost (the estimate as a hint). Its work is an ordinary job.
Disposed: How (Sold · Traded in · Scrapped · Given away · Returned
to the vendor · Lost or stolen · Other), To whom, Price, final
readings. Saving asks first: "Once finalized, nothing new can be
added to Test truck; its records can still be corrected."
Money uses the same amount-and-currency field as jobs.
Every one is a draft for 24 hours, like a fuel-up (Finalize now).
Correcting a disposal offers "It wasn't disposed of after all".
3 · The vehicle's page while it's out for service
A · A banner under the header, on every tab
At Joe's Auto since 14 Nov · due back 20 Nov
B · The header's status chip, and a card on Overview only
Overdue (either option): the chip and banner turn amber, "2 days late", with the same message in Messages (9d). A: always visible; B: quieter, Overview only.
Wide · + Log, Add, and Open issue are hidden for this vehicle
Sold on 2 Dec 2026 to a neighbour
Its records stay; they can be corrected, but nothing new can be added.
Joe's Auto · WO-1182 · due back 20 Nov
